metadata.venue: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri

ai_summary.key_headline: Pride vs. Top Spot: Renard's Tunisia faces Koeman's Netherlands

netherlands: Xavi Simons (Ruptured anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) - Out)

tactical_insights: Memphis Depay and Cody Gakpo's attacking prowess will exploit Tunisia's vulnerable defense.
Eliminated Tunisia, under new manager Renard, plays for pride after two heavy defeats.
Koeman's pragmatic Dutch system will test Renard's attempt to restore Tunisia's defensive solidity.
